releaseNotes:
- Fix release EXE so it starts on clean PCs (bundle WPF/WebView2 native libraries; fixes 1.4.13 crash)
- Auto-create Desktop shortcut when missing after portable/update install
- On install, copy Themes/Packs next to the install EXE when present
- Register install path when applying an update from a portable EXE
- Terminal: Float window icon; remove redundant Disconnect (closing the tab ends the session)
- Deploy Console polish + compact FTP toolbar icons
